'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 2 Reid Smith DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Reid E. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Redneck Rops
* '''Username:''' 3MWDJ8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
